data.description: ABS-01 (w3), ABS-03 (w3), ABS-07 (w2). Schema is ALREADY per-round (rubric_criteria.round_id; round PATCH accepts name/dates/anonymized/mode) — work is UI + one small migration. (1) Round cards become the edit surface: name, date pickers (inline 422 rendering), anonymized toggle (ABS-07 rides free), mode select, per-round Edit scorecard button; root cause is single-array criteria state seeded from rounds[0] (EvaluationPage.tsx:126,167). (2) Migration: criterion kind numeric|select|text + options + scale bounds. TRAPS: assertCriteriaTotal requires weights sum 100 — exempt non-numeric or force 0; editor has no add/remove-criterion controls — add them; criteria_scores wire schema is numbers-only (review.routes.ts:22) — widen. (3) Reviewer renders criteria from queue payload, stores them (kill hardcoded criteria_scores:null at ReviewerPage.tsx:270). (4) REQUIRED: Completed queue section with reopenable read-only reviews — ABS-S3 step 5 must reopen a submitted review to prove storage, else ABS-03 caps at partial forever. (5) Round 2 defaults to scorecard mode (seed + EvaluationPage.tsx:150); keep comparison selectable. (6) Rider: fix unconditional blind-mode redaction copy at ReviewerPage.tsx:420. Full spec: section T-B. Register rows 5,6,8,9. Collision: T-A owns the committee dialog in EvaluationPage.tsx — coordinate/rebase; whoever lands second rebases carefully (one-line JSX merges resolve cleanly and wrongly).

data.body:
PR open: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/79 (branch mrq-108-review-depth @ d3ab3a8, rebased onto github/main @ 10d5986).

LOCAL GATE — npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-108 → PASS in 44.9s (machine load 94):
  worker types · client types · test types · production build — pass
  shell truth — pass | design contract — pass | API contract — pass
  hermetic fast suite — pass, 86 files / 548 tests, 37.25s (45s budget)
  merged AC trace — pass
  pr-gate status: pass, elapsedMs 44915

SHIPPED: migration 0009 (criterion kind/options/scale bounds); round cards became the editing surface (name, dates, anonymized, mode, per-round Edit scorecard, inline 422 on the date field); weights narrowed to a rating-only rule with add/remove criterion controls; reviewer renders + stores the round's criteria; Completed section with reopenable read-only reviews (ABS-S3 step 5 — without it ABS-03 caps at partial); round 2 defaults to scorecard with its own criteria; blind-redaction copy gated on blind_mode.

VALIDATION: real Worker + real D1 + seed, Playwright-driven. Both rounds distinct and editable surviving reload; all three kinds render; 4/2/Accept/comment submitted, moved to Completed, reopened showing stored values. Zero console errors. Two defects found by looking at the screen: round dates rendered in America/New_York against UTC-midnight storage (08/01 displayed 'Jul 31') — formatDate now UTC; and the legacy score strip and the real scorecard both read 'Scorecard' — relabelled 'Overall score (optional)', copy only.

REVIEW — FALLBACK, DISCLOSED: the auto-fired single reviewer timed out at 600s under load 105-172, so per COMMON.md this is a delegator self-review (weaker than fresh eyes). Three findings, all fixed: unbounded completed list on the reviewer hot path (capped 50, truncation surfaced honestly); criteria_scores had no key-count bound (now <=40); duplicate criterion positions gave an opaque 500 (now 422).

DEVIATE-WITH-FLAG: tests/unit/reviewer-surface.AC-61-158-159.test.ts asserted not.toMatch(/detail.identity/) — a blanket source guard pinning the exact defect this ticket's rider names. SPEC.md says anonymized responses strip identity 'from the query payload, not the template', so the guard encoded a mechanism the spec does not use. NARROWED, not deleted: every line mentioning detail.identity must also contain 'detail.blind_mode ?', and the redaction string must still be present. Same file's toContain('criteria_scores: null') asserted the hardcoded null this ticket removes. Contract docs untouched; no AC IDs minted (new tests use the CONTRACT prefix).

CROSS-TICKET: fixed two reds MRQ-109 caught on my tip — mrq-99-organizer-copy pinned the old 'Scorecard (optional)' string, and the bulk-path census had no entry for reviewsForSubmissions. Both green; MRQ-109 can rebase.

HOUSEKEEPING: closed the two stray browser surfaces (482, 483) my timed-out c11 browser open left; none remain in workspace:9. Validation ran headless Playwright, which leaves nothing behind.

Rebased and re-gated. PR #79 is MERGEABLE at c832568 (github/main @ 514f9f4 — MRQ-121, MRQ-113, MRQ-127 landed during my gate run).

Only conflict was cli/api-registry.json, a generated file: took main's through the rebase, then rebuilt and regenerated from the merged tree (134 operations).

RE-GATE ON THE REBASED TIP — npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-108 → PASS, elapsedMs 56893:
  worker types · client types · test types · production build — pass
  shell truth · design contract · API contract — pass
  hermetic fast suite — pass, 87 files / 554 tests, 49.6s (pass-over-budget vs the 45s objective; machine load was 18-55 and rising across the run, and the gate's own budget is 120s)
  merged AC trace — pass

Status stays pr_open. Ready for a human merge — I do not merge.

MERGE ORDERING: MRQ-109's PR #81 is stacked on this branch at c832568 (its delegator confirmed both inherited reds cleared and its gate is green). PR #79 must merge before #81.

If #79 needs another rebase before merge, #81's anchor moves and MRQ-109 has to re-stack — worth a heads-up to that delegator rather than a silent force-push. My branch is untouched since c832568 and I am parked at pr_open.

MERGE QUEUE — position #79 (second). Standing by per the merge captain; NOT rebasing further until told YOUR TURN.

Rebase onto b526d5d was already finished and pushed before the stand-by order arrived, so there is nothing half-done: branch tip fd7e46a, conflict set was only cli/api-registry.json (generated — regenerated with node cli/generate-api-registry.mjs, 135 operations, never hand-resolved). No source conflicts; route-table/quick-search assertions were untouched by this ticket.

RE-GATE AT fd7e46a — npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-108 → PASS, elapsedMs 76798:
  worker/client/test types · production build · shell truth · design contract · API contract — pass
  hermetic fast suite — pass, 89 files / 571 tests
  merged AC trace — pass

SUITE TIMING, for the record: the first attempt reported pr-gate fail at 161979ms — time only, every individual check passed. Load was 78-98 throughout (the '32' in the dispatch was a stale snapshot), and per-file timings put my two touched files (reviewer-queue 14.8s, evaluation 11.5s) BELOW untouched ones (reset-demo 20.7s, decided-not-notified 19.6s); slow files are spread across every ticket's area. The same test code passed the gate three times tonight (44.9s, 56.9s, 76.8s). Ambient contention, not a regression from this branch.

MAIN HAS SINCE MOVED to 2fd9712 (#78 merged), so PR #79 reads CONFLICTING again and fd7e46a is already stale. Expect the same one-file conflict next time — cli/api-registry.json only. Awaiting YOUR TURN.

Reminder for ordering: MRQ-109's PR #81 is stacked on this branch, so it re-stacks after #79 merges.

MERGED — PR #79 auto-merged at 14:38:01Z as ebd697c, while I was mid-gate on the rebase. My force-push was rejected 'stale info' because the branch was already gone. No action outstanding on this ticket.

WHAT LANDED vs WHAT I HAD PREPARED: auto-merge took the pre-rebase tip, which carries migrations/0009_criterion_kinds.sql. Main's own MRQ-115 had already landed migrations/0009_file_comments.sql, so MAIN NOW HAS TWO MIGRATIONS NUMBERED 0009. My in-flight rebase had renumbered mine to 0010 precisely to avoid this; auto-merge beat it by minutes.

Assessed, not guessed — this is untidy, NOT broken:
  - Distinct filenames, so wrangler applies both; verified both apply in order to a real local D1.
  - They touch disjoint tables (rubric_criteria rebuild vs file_comments), so order between them is irrelevant.
  - GitHub's conflict resolution kept BOTH imports in tests/integration/apply-migrations.ts, so the harness runs both.
  The residual risk is convention: the next author sees 0009 twice and any tooling assuming unique numeric prefixes breaks. Renumbering mine to 0010 post-merge is a rename + one import line, if the fleet wants it tidy. I did not do it unasked — it is a main-wide decision during an active merge wave.

SEPARATE PRE-EXISTING BREAK ON MAIN, NOT MINE — scripts/schema-verify.mjs is RED on main:
  'Applied migrations must define exactly 48 product tables' — actual 49, expected 48.
  Cause: MRQ-115's 0009_file_comments.sql creates the file_comments table (a 49th) without bumping the constant.
  Verified by running schema-verify in a pristine detached worktree at github/main (7c064bd) — nothing of mine in the tree.
  It slipped through because schema-verify is NOT one of pr-gate's checks (0 occurrences in scripts/checks/pr-gate.mjs).
  Fix is one line at scripts/schema-verify.mjs:175-176 (48 -> 49, both asserts). Belongs to MRQ-115's owner; flagging rather than drive-by patching mid-wave. Worth considering adding schema-verify to pr-gate so the next one cannot slip.

FINAL GATE ON MY REBASED TIP 3a06bb8 (superseded by the merge, recorded for completeness): pr-gate PASS, elapsedMs 74913, 94 files / 627 tests, all checks green.

Board reconciliation 2026-08-12: verified DONE. PR #79 (mrq-108-review-depth) merged 2026-08-12T14:38:01Z; merge commit ebd697cf confirmed an ancestor of github/main via 'git merge-base --is-ancestor'. Ticket had drifted at pr_open. The repo has zero open and zero closed-unmerged PRs, so nothing is waiting on review. Status corrected to reflect merge, not PR-open.
